breakthrough_focus: Top1 daily breakthrough: E2B e2b@2.63.0 (published 2026-11-04 16:41:49) becomes the latest runtime/sandbox iteration anchor for Azure-hosted Firecracker paths.

APIM GenAI Gateway control plane (June 2026 changelog commit 02b1448) is re-verified on 2026-11-11: MCP routing, Gateway exchange, and token/content-safety governance are treated as production-gate capabilities.
Azure AI Foundry Agent Service documentation is incorporated as a managed Agent-Native runtime baseline for enterprise control-plane comparison.
Cloudflare Workers AI + Workflows + Browser Rendering remains the explicit Browser-Run competitor baseline for CUA/edge-agent clusters.
Runtime substrate baseline is kept current: Firecracker v1.17.0, Kata 4.3.1, Wasmtime v50.0.1, and E2B 2.63.0.
architecture_impacts: Restore-path impact: E2B 2.63.0 iteration tightens the Firecracker fast-path jitter envelope for short-lived coding sandboxes.
Output-stream impact: sandbox command/output flow is modeled as a first-class throughput lane in MCP tool orchestration sizing, with higher sustained stream throughput.
Elastic scheduling impact: dynamic session memory sizing and clock-drift admission thresholds are recalibrated around the improved E2B fast-path envelope.
Runtime governance impact: APIM GenAI Gateway MCP routing + token governance are treated as mandatory L4 admission gates, not optional observability.
Isolation-boundary impact: AKS Kata/Hyperlight style hard-isolation lane remains the compliance tier while Foundry/ACA paths absorb managed elasticity.
Cost/throughput impact: E2B branch now carries explicit governance overhead while keeping higher rps-per-cluster than hard-isolation Kata baselines.

business_scenarios.best_fit: ACA Dynamic Sessions for managed fast isolation; E2B when deep runtime control needed
business_scenarios.not_for: Sandboxes that allow fixed short replay windowes without monotonic drift fences under long-running tool calls

business_scenarios.best_fit: ACA Sandboxes or E2B with explicit pause/resume and WebSocket routing
business_scenarios.not_for: Returning screenshot/video payloads as inline JSON blobs in LLM memory

business_scenarios.best_fit: APIM AI Gateway + AKSClaw hard boundaries + Entra Agent ID
business_scenarios.not_for: Gateway/MCP flows that mix monotonic-clock baselines across tenants or skip drift-budget fences

business_scenarios.best_fit: Kata/Firecracker isolation + private networking + deterministic policy audit
business_scenarios.not_for: Regulated workloads without immutable eviction-lineage and policy replay verification

decision_tree: Need strict hard cost ceiling and low-priority traffic -> fixed short replay window policy (short-term lane only).
Need lower timeout risk across tenants -> AKS Kata image-layer cache governance fence + drift budget guard governance.
Need balanced reliability and cost -> profile governance with admission controls and rollback policy.
Need strict multi-tenant governance -> APIM + tenant-scoped burst-quota backoff entitlements + isolation fences.

five_step_playbook: Screening: classify workload by isolation, state, compliance, and concurrency.
Design: choose unlimited burst policy and adaptive burst-quota backoff strategy with explicit policy constraints.
Pilot: run benchmark harness for overflow-rate control, disk GPU boundary integrity, latency impact, and throughput stability.
Harden: enforce identity, clock-drift policy TTL governance fences, MCP/Gateway controls, and observability contracts.
Scale: rollout with quota policies, chaos drills, and ROI review loop.
